messages:
maria: Heads up — EU edge cluster in AMS is hitting egress-driven OOMs after yesterday's topoff. We're out of spare H100s in the AMS pool. Can procurement push any RMA swaps or air-topups? cc @ajay

ajay: We're showing 12 pending RMAs with Nexa, typical ETA 7–10 business days. I can try to push an expedite but vendor needs AWB details + insurance confirmation from us.

dmitri: If hardware doesn't arrive, we can failover some workloads to FRA. Tradeoff: egress costs + latency bump (~20%). Need numbers to sign off reroute.

leah: Can we borrow some capacity from the Dedicated spare temporarily? Also, any chance of a short-term partner pool burst?

maria: Vendor proposed a partial air-replace: 4 H100 air-replace units, but they require serials for DOA verification and a consolidated AWB under our carrier. They quoted a cost delta of ~ $3k/unit for expedite. Need ops signoff.

Tomas-nexasupply: tomas-nexasupply: We can do 4 units air-replace. ETA ~72 hours after AWB clearance. Shipping = $2.8k + insurance at 1% declared value. We need PO ref and return RMA label for the replaced units. AWB sample: 123-45678901.

ajay: PO 4592-EXP created. Approve insurance at 1%? Which forwarder — DHL Express or Cargolux? DHL tends to clear customs faster in AMS.

dmitri: Approve DHL. Please also set routing policy to failover workloads to FRA at 85% egress saturation so we don't cascade into more pods failing.

leah: I'll add the routing rule and a product-impact alert. Also adding a short retention dev notice for degraded latency.

maria: Tomas — send AWB + provisional proforma invoice to ops@redwood.com. We also need temporary serial placeholders for the air-replace manifest (we'll replace with final serials in the staging handoff).

Tomas-nexasupply: tomas-nexasupply: Will send AWB + proforma within 2 hours. For temp serials we can issue `TEMP-XXXX` placeholders, but customs prefer real serials — please confirm final manifest by midnight UTC.

ajay: Confirmed we'll provide final manifest by 22:00 UTC. Logistics note: vendor must include CN22 and HS code `84733000` on paperwork to avoid unexpected customs hold.

dmitri: One more contingency — if customs holds, we want a split-shipment fallback: FRA hub + AMS depot. Tomas, can you accept split AWBs and a conditional split fee?

Tomas-nexasupply: tomas-nexasupply: Yes, we can split shipments. Additional handling fee $250 per split AWB. We'll add the conditional fee line to the proforma.

maria: Greenlight on the expedite. ajay, please confirm payment terms and cost center. After arrival we'll run staging smoke: kernel burn (6hr), 100GB net egress test, and serial reconciliation.

ajay: Payment = Net7 on expedite PO. Charge shipping to 04-Infra. I'll send payment confirmation and tag finance.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Ticket INF-2251 created and tagged #urgent-provisioning. Tracking: PO=4592-EXP, AWB pending, manifest deadline 22:00 UTC.

maria: Thanks — I'll coordinate on the manifest updates and the staging checklist. If anything goes sideways, escalate to oncall infra.
